tutorial.title: Tutorial
content: In this game, you are the AI and have to answer the users' questions. That's not as easy as it sounds, though, because an AI sees the world differently than a human does.
It doesn't understand the meaning of words — it only recognizes patterns in the data it has seen.
An AI only knows tokens like {token}.
Press and drag the tokens into the answer box to formulate a response.
You can also click on the tokens to see valuable information about them in the sidebar on the right.
Maybe you can even figure out what the tokens' properties stand for.
